**Earflow — Gateway & session (Go api-gateway):**
- CSRF bypass or missing validation on `class: unsafe` mutating routes (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE)
- Client-spoofed identity headers (`X-User-Id`, `X-Service-Token`) trusted without gateway stripping/replacement
- Weakening rate limits, CSRF checks, or header stripping in `gateway.yaml` / proxy handlers
- Stream routes (`class: stream`) missing `require_user` or exposing raw MinIO/internal URLs to browsers
- Auth bypass in custom proxy handlers duplicating policy already defined in yaml

**Earflow — Cookies & tokens:**
- JWT or refresh tokens stored in localStorage/sessionStorage (must be httpOnly cookies: `mp_auth`, `mp_sid`, `mp_csrf`)
- Missing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite on session cookies in prod paths
- Stream/session tickets logged in plaintext or returned in error responses
- `STREAM_TICKET_ENFORCE=1` or mint flags enabled without PoP e2e / SEC-013 browser DoD (prepared≠closed)

**Earflow — Backend (Node/Go services):**
- SQL built via string concatenation with user input (must use parameterized queries)
- Service-to-service calls without `X-Service-Token` / service JWT validation
- Trusting client-sent user id instead of gateway-injected session context
- Missing server-side authz/ownership checks on user-owned resources (IDOR)
- Upload paths without MIME/size/magic-byte validation; path traversal in object keys
- Secrets, recovery codes, MFA seeds, or ticket bodies in logs or API responses

**Earflow — Device Sync & playback authority:**
- Frontend optimistic device ownership (`transferTo(self)`) before backend `cmd:play` intent
- Frontend rebuilding `devices[].isActive` or `nowPlaying.deviceId` locally instead of server frames
- REST polling replacing always-on WebSocket after register (authority drift)

**Earflow — Streaming & WebSocket:**
- HLS/stream 403 infinite retry loops without backoff or session refresh cap
- WS reconnect storms without `gaveUpRef` / storm threshold after repeated handshake failures
- Stream error counting via React `useState` causing render loops (should use refs + backoff)

**Earflow — Edge (nginx):**
- CSP regression (overly permissive `script-src`, missing `object-src 'none'`)
- CORS allowing untrusted origins with credentials
- TLS downgrade or missing HSTS in production server blocks

**Earflow — Artist Portal:**
- Write operations without MFA step-up where required
- CSRF missing on artist gateway unsafe routes
